items.title: Africa's insurance protection gap driven partly by data shortages, report shows
items.summary: The Africa Insurance Pulse 2026 highlights that high-quality data is critical to the market's evolution, as insurers navigate incomplete information across the continent.

items.title: Markel reports 55% surge in underwriting profit for the first nine months
items.summary: Markel Group posted a 92% combined ratio and an increased underwriting profit for the first nine months of the year, supported by disciplined specialty insurance operations.

items.title: HM Revenue & Customs introduces technical changes ahead of 2027 pension IHT rules
items.summary: The government is adding two amendments to upcoming rules that bring unused pension funds and death benefits into the scope of inheritance tax.

items.title: Aviva research shows UK manufacturers face weekly unplanned downtime
items.summary: New research from Aviva reveals that 84% of small and mid-sized UK manufacturers experience unplanned downtime at least once a month.

items.title: CFC executive highlights small business challenge in cyber insurance
items.summary: Reaching small businesses remains an unsolved challenge across the cyber insurance market despite growth in specialist UK broker distribution.

items.title: AXIS Capital reports higher Q3 premiums as acquisition costs widen
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, aXIS Capital posted an 11% rise in reinsurance premiums and a 13% increase in insurance gross premiums written for the third quarter of 2026, alongside higher acquisition and catastrophe costs.
